reviews.reviewText:
MCQs were from YouTube videos (VU Nexus, Key to Success). Accounting return ke questions thay, ABC company batani thi. MCQs were easy, basic formulas aur increase decrease waly fill in the blanks thay.
Subjective: PI aur WACC type questions (assets, liabilities, inventory cost). Scenarios thay, PI value nikalni thi aur solutions with formulas aur working mangay huay thay.

Mcqs totally conceptual nddd difficult 
Short and long from the practice question file
